paths.label: Password / direct registration
paths.reason: Public first-use path; creates a personal identity through createPersonalIdentityForAuth and carries the registration consent submission its caller supplied.

paths.label: Invitation registration
paths.reason: Public first-use path; creates a personal identity for an invited email that has no user yet.

paths.label: First-use magic link
paths.reason: Public first-use path; a consumed magic link for an unknown email creates a personal identity.

paths.label: Passkey registration
paths.reason: Public first-use path; a passkey ceremony for an unknown email creates a personal identity.

paths.label: Phone-code registration
paths.reason: Public first-use path; a verified phone code for an unknown number creates a personal identity.

paths.label: Social-login first use
paths.reason: Public first-use path; a provider callback for an unknown verified email creates a personal identity.

paths.label: Marketplace register route action
paths.reason: The product register form posts through this server-side route action, making it the only non-synthetic HTTP client of the register route; it resolves a registration consent resolution and submits the value it was handed.

paths.label: Marketplace E2E auth helper
paths.reason: Registers synthetic accounts against the real register route; omitting the submission is the shape that failed a hosted CI shard, so it resolves before it registers.

paths.label: Guest buy-now freshness probe
paths.reason: Registers a synthetic probe account against the real register route and resolves before it registers.

paths.label: Stripe money smoke test
paths.reason: Registers a synthetic seller account against the real register route and resolves before it registers; it no longer names a policy version of its own.

paths.label: Protected Identity account administration
paths.reason: Permission-guarded operator action; the operator creating the account is not the consenting subject, so there is no registration moment to bind.

paths.label: Protected Identity user administration
paths.reason: Permission-guarded operator action; the operator creating the user is not the consenting subject.

paths.label: Protected membership administration
paths.reason: Grants membership to an existing user on an existing account; creates no identity.

paths.label: Identity domain deciders
paths.reason: Pure deciders that fold commands into events; no transport, no request, and no consenting subject reaches them.

paths.label: Identity domain decider tests
paths.reason: Drive the deciders directly to assert command-to-event folding; no transport and no shipping surface.

paths.label: Platform-API bootstrap reconciliation database test
paths.reason: Seeds pre-existing aggregate state directly through the command handlers so the bootstrap reconciliation it exercises has something to reconcile; no transport and no shipping surface.

paths.label: Production platform-admin bootstrap
paths.reason: Operator-provisioned admin identity with no human registration moment; revisit when the consent bundle defines an operator-acceptance surface.

paths.label: Admin-QA actor fixtures
paths.reason: Provisions QA actors and already records consent directly; must migrate to the consent bundle once one exists.

paths.label: Development / scenario seed
paths.reason: Non-production seed data that records consent directly; must migrate to the consent bundle once one exists.

compositions.label: Guest checkout account claim
compositions.reason: Composes an Account, User, and Membership out of three unbound primitives without ever reaching createPersonalIdentityForAuth, producing a real owned account. Whether a claimed guest account requires registration consent is a counsel question, not an implementer's call, so the footprint is frozen rather than silently bound: the three member sites are pinned and a fourth member joining the composition must be a reviewed change.
